description: This file defines IPC message-related classes and templates, including ScalarType, Text, BufferType, and type definitions within the WPEFramework::Core::IPC namespace.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar types, specialized for string type.

classes.name: ScalarType<string>
classes.description: Specialization of ScalarType for string type, providing serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text handling, with serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for buffer management, wrapping Core::FrameType and providing serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Getter and setter for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a byte buffer.
